About.title: About Mobile CarCare
About.paragraph1: Mobile CarCare is a convenient mobile car care service that brings professional washing, cleaning and detailing directly to your location.
About.paragraph2: We know your time is valuable. Instead of driving to a car wash and waiting in line, you book online and our trained professionals arrive at your home or workplace at the time you choose.
About.paragraph3: Our packages cover everything from a quick exterior wash to premium detailing with machine polish and paint protection. Pricing is transparent and shown upfront before you confirm your booking.

items.q: How do I book a service?
items.a: Create an account, add your vehicle, then use the booking flow to pick a service, add-ons, location and an available time slot.

items.q: Do you come to my location?
items.a: Yes. Mobile CarCare is fully mobile — a professional travels to the location you provide during booking.
The final price is the service base price plus any add-ons you select. The total is always confirmed by our system before you complete the booking.
Bookings can be scheduled every day between 09:00 and 18:00. Available slots depend on service duration and existing bookings.
Yes. Pending and confirmed bookings can be cancelled from your dashboard. Completed and already-cancelled bookings cannot be cancelled.
You can add any car (sedan, SUV, pickup or luxury) by providing the brand, model, year, color and plate number.

HowItWorks.title: How It Works
HowItWorks.subtitle: Booking a mobile car care service takes less than two minutes.

steps.title: Browse services
steps.text: Choose from exterior wash, interior cleaning, full detailing or premium detailing packages.

steps.title: Create an account
steps.text: Register with your email and add your vehicle details so booking is fast every time.

steps.title: Select your vehicle
steps.text: Pick one of your saved vehicles or add a new one during the booking flow.

steps.title: Pick add-ons
steps.text: Add extras like tire cleaning, engine bay cleaning, leather conditioning or odor treatment.

steps.title: Choose location & time
steps.text: Tell us where your car is and select an available date and time that works for you.

steps.title: We come to you
steps.text: A professional arrives at your location, completes the service and you are done.
